title: DiffOCT: Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular OCT
description: Code accompanying the paper "Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular OCT". It implements a differentiable physics-based OCT forward model (single-scatter Beer-Lambert and multiple-scatter Extended Huygens-Fresnel) in PyTorch and recovers per-pixel optical attenuation and backscattering fraction from a single B-scan by gradient descent. Includes the experiment scripts and the notebooks that render main Figures 1 to 5 from cached data.
